title: "Tackling Concurrency Bugs with TLA+" by Hillel Wayne
summary: Hillel Wayne's Strange Loop talk introducing TLA+ as a specification language for finding concurrency bugs in designs. It covers stalling, race conditions and dropped messages, with PlusCal examples.
why: Recommended as a concise, high-level intro to what TLA+ is and when it helps.

quote.text: If you are new to TLA+ and just want to get the basic idea and use cases, I recommend the talk.
